name: vibebook-plugin
description: Vibebook Claude Code plugin — digest sessions into chronicles + topics, recall past notes before work. Standalone, no extra CLI required. For cross-device sync, see the vibebook npm CLI (separate package).

plugins.name: vibebook
plugins.description: /vibebook digests sessions into chronicles + typed memory + an entity wiki + distilled Q&A. A SessionStart hook auto-injects the project primer so a new session starts already knowing the project. /vibebook-context for deeper recall + entities + past Q&A; /vibebook-recall to dig into chronicles.
